about.title: About {siteName}
about.paragraph1: {siteName} started as a small personal project: a closet full of well-loved clothing that deserved a second life, and a belief that secondhand shopping should feel considered rather than chaotic.
about.paragraph2: Every piece here is selected, inspected and photographed individually. Nothing is mass-listed — what you see is what's actually in stock, and once a piece sells, it's gone for good.
about.paragraph3: Right now this is a one-person shop, hand-picking and shipping every order. The plan is to grow into a marketplace for other sellers doing the same kind of careful, considered secondhand curation — but for now, it's just one closet at a time.
